description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component used for displaying log messages. It implements the LogNode interface to receive log data, formats log entries with priority, tag, message, and exceptions, and appends them to the view. The class supports chaining additional LogNode objects for log processing.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying logs, implementing the LogNode interface, supporting log formatting, and chaining with other LogNode objects.
